House Plants / 02

Polka Dot Begonia

Your quick care reference

Water when

The top 1–2 inches of soil feel dry.

Check about 2.5–5 cm deep with your finger. Avoid constantly wet soil or leaving the entire root ball dry for long.

How to water

Water slowly over the whole soil surface until water drains from the bottom. Let it drain fully, then empty the saucer or outer pot. Direct water onto the soil rather than routinely wetting the leaves.

Fertilizer

Balanced liquid houseplant fertilizer, ½ strength, every 2–4 weeks during spring and summer growth.

Dilute using the product’s label rate. Skip feeding during slow winter growth.

Support / moss pole

A stake helps tall or leaning canes. Use a bamboo stake and loose ties. A moss pole is unnecessary.

Repot / upsize when

  • A root check shows roots densely circling the pot.
  • The soil dries much faster after a thorough watering.
  • The root mass leaves little room for soil.

Next pot: about 1–2 inches (2.5–5 cm) wider, with drainage holes. Spring is the best time.

Check the soil, not the calendar.
Winter usually means longer gaps between watering.
